characters.name: Widow’s Son
characters.prompt: A determined young Norwegian boy, around 16 years old, dressed in worn, homespun woolen clothes common in rural Norway (1400–1850). He has light hair, a slim but sturdy build, and an earnest expression. Imagine threadbare knee-length trousers, a simple linen shirt, and rough leather shoes. He carries a curious, secretive air, reflecting both innocence and courage.

characters.name: The Widow (Mother)
characters.prompt: A weary but caring Norwegian woman in her late 40s, wearing a dark woolen dress with a simple apron. She has a weathered face from hard farm work, with a headscarf or kerchief tied around her hair. Her posture is slightly bent from labor, but her eyes show warmth and love for her only son.

characters.name: The Mysterious Man (Troll)
characters.prompt: A tall, looming figure clad in a long, tattered cloak made of dark fabric. He has a grim, otherworldly presence, with bushy eyebrows and perhaps an unsettling, magical aura. His clothes suggest an ancient style from Norway’s past. He appears powerful and dominating in any scene, with a stern and forbidding countenance.

characters.name: Enchanted Horse (The Hidden Prince)
characters.prompt: A majestic black horse of impressive size, standing in a dimly lit stable from old rural Norway. It has a glossy coat, a strong muscular build, and intelligent eyes that hint at its hidden royal nature. The horse’s stance is proud, with an almost human-like awareness in its expression.

characters.name: The King
characters.prompt: A dignified older man wearing Norwegian-style regalia from the 17th or 18th century. He has a richly embroidered tunic, a fur-trimmed cloak, and a simple yet distinct crown. His posture is authoritative, reflecting the weight of his kingdom on his shoulders, and he holds a scepter or staff.

characters.name: The Princess
characters.prompt: A graceful young Norwegian princess with fair hair, adorned in a modest yet elegant gown from the 17th century. She wears a small golden crown or circlet and a finely stitched bodice over a flowing skirt. Her demeanor is gentle but regal, and her eyes convey kindness and curiosity.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: Illustrate a dramatic medieval Norwegian scene under a bright but cold sky. In the center, show the Widow’s Son astride the majestic black horse, galloping through a rugged, mountainous landscape. The troll-like Mysterious Man and his allies give chase in the distance, their weapons raised. The land is dotted with tall pine trees and old wooden structures. Capture the tension as the boy escapes with the horse’s help, ensuring every character’s attire and setting match the Norwegian style (1400–1850). Use detailed lighting to highlight the grandeur of nature and the magic of the moment.
modernMainImagePrompt: Reimagine the tale in today’s Norway. Depict the Widow’s Son in modern outdoor gear—perhaps a hooded jacket and sturdy hiking boots—riding a sleek black horse along a scenic fjord or a winding road. The Mysterious Man could appear as a tall, mysterious figure in dark modern attire. The hustle of a small modern Norwegian town is in the background, with cars and lampposts. Emphasize the contrast between the age-old magic of the horse and the present-day environment.
childMainImagePrompt: Create a friendly fantasy illustration for young children. Show a cheerful Norwegian countryside with gentle rolling hills and pastel-colored wooden houses. The Widow’s Son, smiling and dressed in simple, bright-colored clothes, sits on a kind-eyed black horse that looks both cuddly and magical. In the background, a kindly King and Princess wave from a castle tower. The Mysterious Man appears funny rather than scary, perhaps peeking from behind a tree. Use soft colors and happy expressions suitable for a 5-year-old audience.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Lag et moderne norsk eventyrbilde: En ung gutt i enkle klær står ved siden av en vakker svart hest på en gårdsvei i norsk natur. I bakgrunnen ser man smale fjorder, høye fjell og en liten kongsgård. Vises også en konge og en prinsesse ved slottsporten, mens en mystisk skikkelse stirrer fra skogkanten. Indiker spenning og eventyr, men hold en vennlig og varm stemning.
englishMainImagePrompt: Depict a rich, old-time Norwegian fairytale scene: the Widow’s Son, dressed in tattered farm clothes, stands beside a grand black horse in a rustic courtyard. A tall forest and timber-built houses are visible under a gray-blue sky. In the distance, a suspicious figure in dark garments lingers near the edge of the trees, while a regal king and a graceful princess watch from a castle balcony. Highlight the atmosphere of mystery, enchantment, and courage that pervades the original tale.
